Tanis Alderwood is a Forsaken located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He is a beggar who wishes for the apothecaries of the Royal Apothecary Society to stitch his wife together. As part of their lesson in divinity, Danitha Morr sent the adventuring paladin to aid Tanis. He initially feared the adventurer, but soon realized they were here to help, so he tasked them with getting him fresh cloth so that he could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while they waited for the apothecaries. When the paladin returned with the cloth, Tanis was grateful for the help and proclaimed himself a friend.
Tauren Plainswalkers are tauren and Highmountain tauren found in Sanguine Grasps in Hallowfall. They are fighting against Xal'atath's Kaheti nerubians during the defense of the Aegis Wall.

Tazavesh Customs Enforcement is an area located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. Within this area, Cartel Zo inspects those seeking to enter Tazavesh. The first boss of the instance, Zo'phex, can be fought here -- seeking to stop any unauthorized intruders to the city. By the time of war on K'aresh, Tazavesh Customs Enforcement is no more. Instead, Tazarest and Astral Getaways are in its place. Functionally, it has been replaced by the Xy Imports Offices and Xy Imports Receiving, which, as the name implies, is now handled by Cartel Xy instead of Zo.

Tefferty Ulreth is an Arathi located at Beledar's Bounty in Hallowfall. He once assisted Wenren Althal in his research in hopes of being reunited with his wife, who stayed back in their homeland, until he secretly joined the Order of Night and was ordered to kill Wenren. He then destroyed the mage's research to prevent reinforcements from the Arathi Empire, and was later tracked down and killed by an adventurer.

The Temporal Missive: Shadowforge City is one of the temporal missives needed for the A Dark Iron Past achievement. This missive spawns in the room immediately after Fineous Darkvire.

There are three possible apprentices that can be chosen: Barian Maryla, Kaigy Maryla, or Sairuh Maryla. Each one has different abilities and drops.

The Lost One is a nerubian sage depicted by a statue in the Skeins in the City of Threads, on the northeastern side of the Royal Preservatorium. The statue's plaque can only be understood while under the effects of Potion of Polymorphic Translation: Nerubian. Although the statue looks like a trueborn nerubian, the plaque's mention of memory strands makes it clear that the subject was a sageform.

The Power of Temptation concludes the quest chain to acquire Fyr'alath the Dreamrender. To have reached this point, players must have looted the shadowflame version of Fyr'alath the Dreamrender (shadowflame) from Fyrakk the Blazing in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope and acquired the necessary items to temper the shadowflame that had consumed the player after their first attempt at equipping the axe.

The Power of Dreams is the second step to getting the Incandescent Essence helm enchant. To begin, loot the Twisted Dreaming Essence from Gnarlroot in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope, complete the quest it starts, then spend the next few weeks killing more bosses to collect enough Echoed Ephemera. This quest is time-gated and the earliest players can complete it is the week of 12 December 2023.
The Power of Dreams is the final step to getting the Incandescent Essence helm enchant. The previous quest is time-gated and the earliest players can complete it is the week of 12 December 2023.

The Soundness is a derelict Arathi airship found in the Undersea off the coast of Hallowfall. It was part of the Third Fleet, and it was likely one of the airships lost when the fleet was teleported to Hallowfall by Beledar. Sky Captain Roed was in charge; according to his journal, some of the crew were voicing concerns regarding the mission and the emperor's vision. He was quick to quell these ideas and sent both Mariners Smite and Solace to the brig for speaking against the emperor's guidance.
The Shadowguard Shattered concludes the first chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign. Chapter two, "Void Alliance", starts immediately after with What Is Left of Home.

The Undermine Open was a community-driven boomball tournament in World of Warcraft. Hosted by streamers, Xaryu and Pikaboo, the event features unconventional golfing mechanics, explosive hazards, and goblin-style unpredictability. Participants compete in a unique Azerothian sports setting, where strategy and chaos collide. The tournament showcases creativity within the WoW community, offering an entertaining twist on traditional in-game competitions.

The War Within is the first quest in the The War Within campaign. It is automatically offered to level characters starting the week of 30 July 2024. When heading to Silithus: The Wound, it may be necessary to speak with Zidormi in Valor's Rest to change phases. If one has dropped or otherwise lost the quest, returning to Stormwind City or Orgrimmar will cause it to pop up again. It can also be picked up from the Adventure Guide's "Suggested Content" tab.

The Three Winds is an ethereal-run shop found within the Canals in Stormwind City. Formerly the location of The Finest Thread, it is located behind The Stockade, across the water and bordering Cathedral Square. Utilizing their ethereal technomancy to create a lucrative business, the ethereal offer a variety of services here, including void storage, transmogrification, and item upgrades.
Three of Serpents is one of the cards that can be obtained from Darkmoon Card of Mists. It is one of the cards needed to create Serpent Deck.

Thrillbot 9000 is a robot companion that can be purchased at the Trading Post for 250 Trader's Tender. It was previously obtained from the Mountain Dew Gaming promotion by purchasing , , or products, which included codes that could be redeemed on the [https://www.mtndewgaming.com/ MTN Dew Gaming Program] website for points to redeem rewards such as this pet, which required 400 points. The promotion ran from 4 November 2024 to 31 January 2025.

Thrill of the Chase is an exploartion achievement earned for avoiding the Hungering Presence in the Voidstorm for at least 60 seconds. Fly high up into the sky and descend at an angle that lowers your altitude very little while keeping the Skyriding's Thrill of the Skies active (as indicated by the blue aura).

Timegating is a game design strategy where access to content, rewards, or progression is limited solely by time-based constraints rather than gameplay progression. In World of Warcraft, this often means delayed unlocks of campaign chapters, staggered raid releases, or seasonal or event-based availability. Timegating is used to extend engagement, prevent burnout, and control pacing, but it has also been criticized for limiting player agency and creating artificial barriers.
